vulnerability.name: Secret in process environment
vulnerability.author: Thomas Shaw
vulnerability.description: A long-running process started with a secret in its environment. The value is XOR-obfuscated in the on-disk binary and decoded into the process environment only at runtime, then inherited by a quiet sleeper it execs, so the plaintext lives only in that process's memory. It is recoverable from a RAM image by searching the raw capture (strings), not from any file on disk. Teaches that a process's environment block is volatile evidence.
vulnerability.hint: A process keeps the environment it was started with for its whole life, in memory.
vulnerability.solution: Search a RAM capture for the environment variable (strings on the image, grep for TELEMETRY_TOKEN=) and read the token from it; it is not present in any file on disk.
